default.notes: Apply for the 30-day eVisa at evisa.gov.so; in practice a visa on arrival (about USD 60, cash) is still widely issued at Mogadishu's Aden Adde airport — confirm current practice with your airline before departure.

SO.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Somali citizens.

IL.notes: Somalia does not recognise Israel and Israeli passport holders are refused entry.
